moves.name:
Almighty
Mortal Spin
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When there is at least one Pokémon with a lowered Type Rebuff on the opponent’s field of play.
Deactivation Condition:
Cannot be deactivated.

Never misses. Lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def by [Digit:1digit ] stat [EN:Qty S="rank" P="ranks" ]. Leaves the target poisoned. Removes a damage field from the allied field of play. Removes the trapped condition from the user.

moves.name: Potion
moves.description: Restores an ally’s HP by approximately [Digit:2digits ]% of its maximum HP.

moves.name:
Almighty
Venoshock
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When there is at least one Pokémon affected by a status condition on the opponent’s field of play.
Deactivation Condition:
When there are no longer any Pokémon affected by a status condition on the opponent’s field of play.

Never misses. This attack’s power is doubled when the target is poisoned or badly poisoned. Applies the Physical Move Break effect and Special Move Break effect to the target the first time this attack move is successful each battle. Turns the field of play’s zone into a [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ]. (A [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] powers up [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="1" ]-type attacks.) Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:1digit Idx="2" ] [EN:Qty Ref="2" S="rank" P="ranks" ].

moves.name:
The Guiding
Light!
moves.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by two. Uses a maximum of [Digit:1digit ] [EN:Qty S="slot" P="slots" ] of the user’s move gauge. The more amount used, the more it raises the Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, and Sp. Def of all allied sync pairs (can be raised by up to [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ] maximum).

moves.name:
Dazzling Brilliance
Divine Mortal Spin
moves.description: Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:1digit ] [EN:Qty S="rank" P="ranks" ] the first time the user’s sync move is used each battle.

passives.name: Toxic Myth
passives.description: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits ]%. Reduces attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits Idx="1" ]%. The more allied sync pairs with [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by 10% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is [Digit:2digits Idx="3" ]%, and the maximum damage reduction is [Digit:2digits Idx="4" ]%.)

passives.name: Toxic Judgment
passives.description: Raises the [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ] the first time the user enters a battle each battle. Lowers the [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] of all opposing sync pairs by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ] the first time the user enters a battle each battle.

passives.name: Incapable of Holding Back
